verdict.rationale: Calendly's own Workflows feature automates pre- and post-meeting emails and texts, which run on timing relative to each booked meeting, and it supports one-click scheduled reminder emails. These are meeting-anchored automations, not user-defined recurring or cron-style jobs, and the webhooks are event-triggered rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: arbitrary recurring or cron-style workflow scheduling, documentation of time-based triggers independent of meetings, API/MCP control of scheduled workflows, independent corroboration.
